en.headline: Government to roll out four new signature tourism projects from fourth quarter
en.dek: The batch includes industrial brand tours at bus depots and MTR exhibits, a miniature city display at the Peak, temple digitalisation and Yuen Long seasonal events.
body: The Working Group on Developing Tourist Hotspots, led by Deputy Chief Secretary for Administration Cheuk Wing-hing, will progressively launch four new signature tourism projects from the fourth quarter of 2026.

Phase two of Hong Kong industrial brand tourism will add visits to Kowloon Motor Bus depots, the MTR “Station Rail Voyage: Explorer” exhibition and Beijing Tong Ren Tang’s Hong Kong production and research base, using a group-in, group-out format.

Madame Tussauds Hong Kong will recreate a Hong Kong Miniature City Exhibition at the Peak Tower with new miniature art exhibits of landmarks and local life. The Chinese Temples Committee is also adding QR-code boards and an app so visitors can learn about temple antiquities and redeem cultural souvenirs.

In Yuen Long, the district office will partner with local groups on a “Yuen Long Good Times” programme featuring seasonal themes such as Tin Hau Festival processions and autumn nature visits for red leaves and migratory birds.

zh.headline: 政府第四季起推四項新特色旅遊項目涵蓋工業品牌及廟宇文化
zh.dek: 項目包括九巴車廠及港鐵展覽參觀、山頂微型城市展、廟宇數碼化，以及元朗季節性地區活動。
body: 由政務司副司長卓永興領導的發展旅遊熱點工作組，將於二○二六年第四季起逐步推出四個新的特色旅遊項目，為旅客提供更多具香港特色的深度體驗。
第二階段香港工業品牌旅遊將新增九龍巴士車廠、港鐵「載遇‧站見」鐵路展及北京同仁堂香港生產研發基地，旅客可透過團進團出形式參觀。
香港杜莎夫人蠟像館將於第四季在山頂凌霄閣重塑香港微型城市展，加入新的微型藝術展品。華人廟宇委員會亦正加強直轄廟宇的二維碼展示及手機應用程式，讓訪客互動認識文物並換取文創紀念品。
元朗民政事務處將與地區團體合作推出「元朗好時節」，鼓勵旅客按季節探索地區特色，例如天后誕會景巡遊及秋冬尋紅葉、覓候鳥等活動。
